high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "readingroomindia." The post features a photograph of a plate of food, specifically what appears to be dosa (a type of Indian flatbread) served with chutney and sambar, which are traditional accompaniments. The text overlay on the image provides historical context about MTR Foods, a well-known Indian food company. It reads: "The Maiyas realised that the hardship was a blessing in disguise. India was changing. Women were getting out to work. There was an emerging market for MTR ready mix products.
